items.title: In 1980, Idaho’s ‘French Fry King’ Acquired 40% Of A Struggling Startup Called Micron, Operating Out Of A Boise Dentist’s Office. His Stake Would Be Worth Well Over $400 Billion Today, If Any Of It Were Still In His Descendants’ Hands.
